title: Qafila Hussain ka
body:
Rakh Ke Dosh Pe Alam Azm Kar Barha Qadam
Kar Yaqeen Tujhse Door Aaj Bhi Nahi Hua

Haq Pasand Hai Agar Aur Der Ab Na Kar
Intezar Kar Raha Hai Haq Ki Rah Par Khada

Ek Baar Aankh Band Karke Hur Ko Yaad Kar
Wo Sakhi Hussain Hai
Fatima Ka Chain Hai
Kashtiye Nijaat Usko Mil Gayi Jisey Mila

Khul Ke Bol Zulm Ke Khilaaf Kar Sada Buland

Sahebuz Zaman Ro Rahe Hain Tu Khamosh Hai
Gaflaton Ko Chhod De
Khud Ko Unse Jod De
Apne Hamiyon Ko De Raha Hai Aaj Bhi Sada

Do Jahan Me Sirf Aisa Ek Hi Hai Karwan
Apna Ghar Luta Ke Jo Basaye Deen Ki Bastiyan
Marziye Khuda Hai Ye
Seedha Rasta Hai Ye
Bandagi Ki Qayanat Me Misaal Ban Gaya

Aye Nadeem Soch Kya Jawab Dega Tu Unhe
Hashr Me Agar Imame Asr Tujhse Puchh Len
Kaisa Intezar Tha
Kya Ye Mujhse Pyar Tha
Nafs Ke Aseer Tune Kis Liye Nahi Chuna
